plans.prompt: First-person point of view, close-up on two young hands in dark suit sleeves, a plain gold wedding ring on the left hand, resting still on a dark wooden desk at night. An old beige CRT computer monitor directly ahead casts a steady deep red glow over the hands; no readable text on screen. Behind the monitor, rain streaks a tall dark window. The camera slowly dollies straight forward over the hands toward the window. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, cold desaturated tones, film grain.

Slow steady forward dolly at eye level along a long line of people under dark umbrellas waiting in heavy rain, leading to a closed rusted factory gate centered at the end of the frame, centered one-point perspective. Seen from behind, some wear plain solid orange work jackets. Faces not visible. No signs, no logos, no readable text, no flags. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, cold desaturated tones, film grain.

Slow steady forward dolly down the center of an empty supermarket aisle at night, centered one-point perspective, the metal shelves on both sides completely bare. A single fluorescent tube on the ceiling flickers and then goes dark, leaving the aisle almost black. No people, no logos or readable text. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, cold desaturated tones, film grain.

First-person point of view, close-up on a hand resting on a computer mouse on a dark wooden desk. A plain gold wedding ring and a wristwatch are clearly visible on the wrist. The hand presses the mouse button once. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

A dim, empty hospital corridor at night, seen from the middle of the hallway. Warm ceiling lights switch on one by one in sequence down the corridor, pushing back the darkness. No people visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, slow push-in, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

Slow steady forward dolly down the center of a supermarket aisle in the early morning, centered one-point perspective, the metal shelves on both sides completely full of fresh unwrapped bread, fruit and plain unlabeled goods, warm golden light. A few shoppers seen from behind at the far end. No logos, no packaging text, no readable text. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, warm golden early-morning light, film grain.

Slow steady forward dolly toward a large rusted factory gate centered in the frame at sunrise, centered one-point perspective, wet pavement. The gate slides open from left to right, revealing bright low sunlight behind it. A group of workers in plain solid orange work jackets stands in front of the gate, seen from behind, faces not visible. No signs, no logos, no readable text, no flags. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, soft warm dawn light, film grain.

First-person point of view standing close to a tall window in a dark wood-paneled office in the early morning. Only an older forearm in a dark suit sleeve and a hand wearing a plain gold wedding ring enter from the left and pull a heavy dark curtain open from left to right in one smooth motion; bright warm sunlight floods in and flares into the lens. No person, body or face visible, no reflection in the glass. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, lens flare, film grain.

Slow steady forward steadicam move at eye level through a sunny, lived-in old city square: children run ahead of the camera in the same direction, families walk, a small open-air market with plain awnings without lettering, laundry on balconies, irregular old buildings, people doing different things. No flags, no banners, no signs, no readable text. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.

Slow motion, side view: young people run from left to right along a low wooden pier and leap into a clean, clear river on a bright sunny day, water bursting into sparkling splashes. No close-up faces. No readable text. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.

Aerial shot rising steadily and moving straight ahead above a clean river winding through a lived-in green city in daylight: irregular rooftops, parks full of people, tree-lined banks, asymmetric organic layout. No flags, no flagpoles, no signs, no readable text. Cinematic, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.

Aerial shot gliding straight forward over a green ridge, revealing a wide valley as the sun breaks over the far hills in the center of the frame and floods it with golden light: a lived-in small town with irregular red roofs, patchwork fields, a train crossing a stone bridge over a river. No flags, no signs, no readable text. Cinematic, golden sunlight, lens flare, film grain.

First-person point of view, medium close-up over a dark wooden desk in warm morning sunlight: an old beige CRT computer monitor fills the upper half of the frame, its screen glowing soft white with no readable text; directly behind it, an open window full of bright sunlight in the center of the frame, a white curtain moving gently in the breeze. In the foreground an elderly hand wearing a plain gold wedding ring rests still on a computer mouse. Face not visible. Very slow push-in. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.

First-person point of view, same framing: medium close-up over a sunlit dark wooden desk, an old beige CRT monitor glowing soft white with no readable text in the upper half, an open sunlit window with a white curtain behind it. The elderly hand with a plain gold wedding ring lets go of the computer mouse and slowly withdraws out of the bottom of the frame, leaving the mouse alone on the desk. Face not visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.
